instruction: Query the OQMD database for elemental Cu (element_set=Cu AND ntypes=1), extract band_gap/volume/delta_e/stability, and save to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_7.txt'.
